title: build(deps-dev): bump @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin from 8.72.0 to 8.72.1
intent: Dev-tooling currency, no advisory. The title names one package but this moves the WHOLE @typescript-eslint family in lockstep: eslint-plugin 8.72.1 declares peerDependencies @typescript-eslint/parser ^8.72.1 and pins its internals (scope-manager, type-utils, utils, visitor-keys) to exactly 8.72.1, so npm moves parser and every internal with it. 8.72.1 (2026-10-26) is fixes only: no-unnecessary-condition false positives on unresolved conditional types (#13062); no-unnecessary-type-assertion bounds recursive type traversal instead of catching stack overflows (#13039); typescript-estree uses one Program per tsconfig for the project service in single-run mode (#12988). GitHub's advisory database returns 0 vulnerabilities for eslint-plugin and parser.
behavior_change: None in shipped output and none in lint results, verified by running both rather than assumed. TEN packages moved, not one. Lockfile vs merge base eafbad16 (= origin/main at audit, 0 behind): 400 entries before and after, ZERO added, ZERO removed, exactly ten node_modules entries version-changed, all 8.72.0 -> 8.72.1: @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, parser, project-service, scope-manager, tsconfig-utils, type-utils, types, typescript-estree, utils, visitor-keys. Root differs only in devDependencies['@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin'] ^8.72.0 -> ^8.72.1; the declared parser range stays ^8.71.2 (satisfied by 8.72.1). The family is consistent at one version, which typescript-eslint requires. A/B eslint (`eslint . --ext .ts,.vue --format json`, the lint:report command) with the family at 8.72.0 vs 8.72.1 on the same tree: 6962 vs 6962 distinct (file,line,rule,severity,message) tuples, zero added, zero removed -- the two changed rules produce no different results on this codebase. check_client_lint_ratchet.py on the 8.72.1 report: PASS (errors 34/34, warnings 6979/7683). No client src file imports @typescript-eslint (references are eslint-disable comments only) and neither vite.config nor vitest.config loads eslint, so the production bundle cannot change.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves devDependencies['@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin'] from ^8.72.0 to ^8.72.1. package-lock.json moves the ten @typescript-eslint/* entries 8.72.0 -> 8.72.1 (version, resolved, integrity, internal pins) and updates the root range. Dependabot's incidental peer-flag churn on 16 entries (15 with unchanged versions, plus the 'peer' key on parser) was reverted so nothing else moves.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency; this manifest exists because Dependabot cannot author one (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001). typescript-eslint-8.72.0-bump.json covers the previous PR's diff, not this one; borrowing it is what the rule refuses -- PR #296's silent zod 4 -> 3 revert is why.

Lockfile enumerated as data (both package-lock.json trees parsed, every `packages` entry compared in full), not read from the diff view.

Dependabot's npm flipped the 'peer' flag on 16 entries; per the convention set in ec88eedd (#432) that churn is reverted -- the committed lockfile is the merge-base lockfile plus the real deltas only, with base key order preserved (re-enumerated after the revert: only the root entry and the ten @typescript-eslint entries differ from base; zero peer-flag differences; every changed diff line is a version/resolved/integrity/pin line).
Integrity of all ten moved entries == `npm view @typescript-eslint/<pkg>@8.72.1 dist.integrity`; all ten carry SLSA v1 provenance attestations; none has preinstall/install/postinstall scripts.
